coverage_notes.summary: No new qualifying U.S. or territory healthcare-access development was identified since the prior hourly check. CMS Public Notices was checked first; its newest entries remained dated 2026-09-25. Targeted searches covered hospital/ED, maternity, behavioral health, dialysis, oncology, primary care, rural emergency service loss, ambulance/EMS, air-medical bases, concrete service restorations, U.S. territories, and official state/public-health notices. Older, proposed, non-service-change, unsupported, and duplicate items were excluded.
